text:
The cause is likely something else because firmware 3.4.0 on TRN-077 already fixes stuck forwarding after SFP replacement.

1. Consult a domain expert to investigate the root cause further.

The known port disable/enable workaround does NOT apply to TRN-077 because firmware 3.4.0 resolves traffic getting stuck after optics changes (Erkki Expert, email, 2026-04-08; moderate confidence, confirmed on TRN-077).

What did not work:
- Rebooting the whole unit failed on TRN-015 (Mikko Mäkelä, teams, 2025-06-30).
- Replacing the SFP again failed on TRN-031 (Tiina Tuominen, teams, 2025-07-15).
